questions.ask: Which languages does this repo's code use?
questions.why: Installs the no-any and dead-code rules for those languages (they load only while Claude edits such files), and for TypeScript the double-assertion check.
questions.detect: package.json or tsconfig.json at the root means typescript; pyproject.toml means python; both files mean both

questions.ask: Turn on Claude Code's Bash sandbox for this repo?
questions.why: The operating system then stops every command Claude runs from reading real .env files or writing an unlock token, whatever the command line says; the hooks alone only read command text. Linux and WSL2 need bubblewrap and socat; where the sandbox cannot start, Claude Code warns and runs without it.
questions.detect: .claude/settings.json already has a sandbox key: yours is kept either way

questions.ask: Add the kit's .mcp.json (Serena, GitHub, Context7, and read-only dev and production database servers)?
questions.why: The servers the commands and hooks expect, each pinned to one release; secrets stay ${VARIABLE} references resolved from your shell. Claude Code asks before it starts a project server. Servers you need now and then (a deploy platform, a VPS provider, Cloudflare) come as .claude/mcp/*.example.json files you load for one session instead. An existing .mcp.json is kept either way.
questions.detect: .mcp.json exists: it is left alone; compare it with the template

questions.ask: Offer these plugins to teammates who open the repo?
questions.why: Adds the agent-config-kit marketplace and agent-core to .claude/settings.json (extraKnownMarketplaces, enabledPlugins), so Claude Code prompts each teammate to install them.
questions.detect: a solo or private repo may not need it
